title: Entity screenshot selection
responsibility: Selects matching recorded screenshots and builds gallery items while retaining capture provenance and explicit gaps.

inputs.name: screenOptions.scenarios
inputs.description: Scenario declarations; only those with viewports become screenshot choices.

inputs.name: screenPick.wanted
inputs.description: Partial requested selection; unknown choices fall back to the first available choice at each level.

inputs.name: entityScreens.evidence
inputs.description: Host-selected evidence for the current revision or compared revisions.

inputs.name: entityScreens.pick
inputs.description: Selected scenario, state and viewport, or null when there is no visual scenario.

inputs.name: galleryItems.evidence
inputs.description: Evidence whose screenshot and audio captures should become gallery items.

inputs.name: catalogShot.evidence
inputs.description: The host-selected evidence for one entity at the shown revision. Captures from other states or entities must already be excluded by its declared coverage.

inputs.name: catalogShot.preview
inputs.description: Optional exact scenario, state and viewport for the catalog image. If absent, choose usable evidence with fresh captures first. If specified but missing, return no image.

outputs.name: screenOptions
outputs.description: Scenario choices with required states and labeled viewport dimensions.

outputs.name: screenPick
outputs.description: Resolved choice, or null when no scenarios exist. Missing state or viewport choices become an empty string.

outputs.name: entityScreens
outputs.description: After screenshot or explicit gap, plus before at a selected commit. Matches scenario/state/viewport exactly; current mode rejects a non-current capture rather than borrowing it. Includes freshness and inherited-origin information.

outputs.name: galleryItems
outputs.description: Before media then after media in commit mode, or current media alone, with sequence order, status, provenance and media details. Includes recorded screenshot/audio items even when unusable or inherited, retaining their labels. Source identifies the capture build revision, never the target of inherited proof.

outputs.name: catalogShot
outputs.description: A usable screenshot of the shown version, preferring a fresh capture. Validated unchanged evidence keeps its original captured commit, standing and explanation. Returns null for missing, rejected, unvalidated, wrong-build or unrelated evidence; never borrows from the parent.
